en: The image appears to be a vintage black-and-white postcard with a printed wooden frame. It shows a large, two-story neoclassical building surrounded by trees and smaller structures. The landscape features hilly terrain in the background. The caption at the bottom reads 'Syra, Ecole Française,' indicating the subject is a French school in Syra (now known as Syros). The website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' is also visible on the image.
